nodes.label: Control API Endpoint Contract
nodes.rationale: All /v1 paths require a verified tenant principal and return the RFC 9457 problem union; cross-tenant detail IDs return the same 404 as absent IDs so tenancy cannot be probed.

nodes.label: Signed Idempotent Actions
nodes.rationale: Action HTTP acceptance is never an execution receipt; clients reconcile by action ID instead of retrying blindly, and challenges are one-use.

nodes.label: One-Use Stream Tickets
nodes.rationale: Browser WebSocket upgrades carry only a 30-second one-use ticket (with CSRF for cookies) while native upgrades carry a bearer header.

nodes.label: Cursor Domain Separation
nodes.rationale: Relay upload cursors (local_log_seq), global cloud ingestion (cloud_ingest_seq), and stream replay (session_seq) are deliberately non-interchangeable to prevent cross-domain replay confusion.
